data.title: Netanyahu condemns settler attack in flashpoint West Bank village
data.description: QUSRA (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Dozens of Israeli settlers attacked the Palestinian village of Qusra in the northern occupied West Bank on Saturday after nearly three weeks of tension in the area, drawing rare condemnation from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

data.title: In London, son's agonising wait for news of parents missing in Nepal-Tibet floods
data.description: LONDON - Since a catastrophic flood struck the border area between Nepal and Tibet, Prajval Haldia in London has had no word from his parents who were on a pilgrimage in the region at the time.

data.title: Pressure rises on EC over probe
data.description: <p>The Election Commission (EC) is facing a credibility test as it schedules a vote on the Senate collusion case for Sept 14. Opposition figures warn that this decision could reshape the political system.</p>

data.title: Insurgency 'renewing itself'
data.description: <p>The latest unrest in the southern border provinces shows an insurgency adapting faster than the state's response, demanding a strategy beyond military containment.</p>

data.title: Covid-19 infections, deaths on rise
data.description: <p>The number of Covid-19 cases has risen in recent months, with 95,357 infections and 14 deaths recorded from Jan 1 to Friday.</p>

data.title: Nepal-China floods: Latest developments
data.description: KATHMANDU - The number of people missing in the catastrophic flood that sliced through the border area between Nepal and Tibet neared 3,000 on Saturday, as rescuers scoured deep, leg-sucking mud for survivors.

data.title: At least 37 dead after Russian strike on depot near Kyiv
data.description: KYIV - At least 37 people have died after a Russian drone struck a depot near Kyiv’s western suburbs overnight, sparking a huge fire and explosions, authorities said on Saturday.

data.title: Widow of man who died in 2024 turbulence sues airline
data.description: A British woman whose husband died after severe turbulence that forced a Singapore Airlines flight to make an emergency landing in Bangkok two years ago has begun legal action against the airline.

data.title: At least 27 dead after Russian strike on depot near Kyiv
data.description: KYIV - At least 27 people have died after a Russian drone struck a depot near Kyiv’s western suburbs overnight, sparking a huge fire and explosions, authorities said on Saturday.

data.title: Iceland votes on whether to resume EU membership talks
data.description: REYKJAVIK - Icelanders began voting on Saturday in a referendum on whether to resume membership negotiations with the European Union, in a tight race that will be closely watched in Brussels.

data.title: Niger military repels coup attempt
data.description: Niger’s national television station went off air on Saturday after a night of heavy gunfire in parts of the capital Niamey, including around a military base near the city’s airport which has been attacked twice this year by jihadists.

data.title: Fire-hit Klongthom Center can’t be saved, says Chadchart
data.description: Fire broke out again on Saturday afternoon at Klongthom Center in Bangkok, after a major blaze overnight caused extensive damage to the popular market for second-hand goods, electronics, spare parts and tools.

data.title: Forum warned about ‘takeover’ of country
data.description: People’s Party leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has warned that alleged irregularities in the 2024 Senate election were the starting point of an attempt to gain control of the country.

data.title: Cambodia says no online scam compounds remain
data.description: ​The Cambodian government has claimed a milestone ‌in its fight against the scam industry accused of stealing billions of dollars from victims around the world, with officials saying they have eradicated all scam compounds in the country.

data.title: Work at Klongthom Center fire scene continues
data.description: Heat and combustible materials continued to pose risks inside the partly collapsed Klongthom Center building in Bangkok on Saturday after a massive fire on Friday night, with the blaze largely under control but officials warning of potentially toxic smoke.

data.title: Norway, in mourning, enters new era under Haakon VIII
data.description: OSLO - Norway opened a new chapter in its history on Saturday under King Haakon VIII, after the death of his father Harald, a unifying figure who was on the throne for 35 years.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nico Carrillo posts negative anti-doping result after Superbon calls for drug test
data.description: Nico Carrillo has hit back at Superbon’s call for him to be drug-tested by publishing a ONE Championship letter stating that his latest in-competition anti-doping test returned a negative result.

data.title: Thailand Hosts Global Sanitation Leaders at World Toilet Summit 2026
data.description: The Asian Institute of Technology (AIT) and the World Toilet Organization (WTO) today announced that the World Toilet Summit 2026 will take place from 17 to 19 November 2026 at the AIT campus in Pathum Thani, Thailand, closing on 19 November, United Nations World Toilet Day. The summit marks the World Toilet Organization’s 25th anniversary.

data.title: Next stage of budget bill debate set for Sept 7-9
data.description: <p>The House of Representatives is expected to consider the 2027 fiscal budget bill in its second and third readings from Sept 7-9, according to the special committee scrutinising the bill.</p>

data.title: Huai Khwang pub raided, nominee structure suspected
data.description: A pub in Huai Khwang district of Bangkok was found to have reopened without a proper licence after previously being ordered to close, with authorities also suspecting a nominee ownership arrangement.

data.title: Bangkok launches new campaign to help homeless
data.description: <p>The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has launched a multi-agency operation to connect homeless people on Rattanakosin Island with shelter, healthcare and social services.</p>
